svg.title: tl-rewrite returns an equivalent normal form
svg.desc: A formula document goes into rewrite, which applies the 38 enabled rules of the catalog (2 more are excluded) bottom-up, first match, under explicit budgets, and returns a RewriteReport whose output is the normal form. replay re-runs the request and reports Verified or Mismatch. check_equivalence compares the original and the normal form on every trace within the horizon and reports Equivalent, or Mismatch with the first counterexample trace.
